notes: Parent: Mortex Products, Inc. (page fact). Sister/similar brands on page: Mortex, Summit; sisters field lists Mortex only (Summit is itself). The schema has no day field, so the page's day value (4th-5th characters) is recorded here in notes and not encoded. The nomenclature diagram image (Style-1_Summit-Date-of-Manufacture_Serial-Number-Nomenclature.png) is corroboration only: month, day and year positions are all stated in text, so no field is held for the image pass.

styles.era: Style 1: letter + 10 digits, MMDDYY date block
styles.notes: Source-page example S0121030140: page 1-based month 2nd-3rd, day 4th-5th, year 6th-7th characters, converted to 0-based half-open month [1,3] and year [5,7] -> month '01', day '21' (not encoded, no schema field), year '03' -> 2003. Character counting verified against the page's asterisked date block '012103' (chars 2-7 = MMDDYY); digit-only counting would give month '12', day '10', year '30' (ambiguous: 1930 below floor, 2030 future) and contradicts the asterisked block, so it is falsified. Second example is constructed (labeled here) and decodes under this file's own rules.
